issues.title: 第三国传输风险: United States
issues.description: 数据涉及向非充分性认定第三国的传输。TIA=缺失，Schrems II 补充措施=不足。
issues.recommended_action: 完成 TIA；针对第三国法律环境实施 Schrems II 补充措施。

issues.title: [HIGH] Clause 14: Third country transfer identified to: United States. No Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) has been pr
issues.description: Third country transfer identified to: United States. No Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) has been provided. Under GDPR and Schrems II (C-311/18), a documented TIA is required before transferring personal data to a third country without an adequacy decision.
issues.recommended_action: Complete a TIA for transfers to United States. The TIA must: (1) assess the laws and practices of the destination country; (2) evaluate whether they impinge on the SCCs' effectiveness; (3) identify and implement supplementary measures as needed.

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex II: Third country transfer to non-adequate jurisdiction 'United States' requires Schrems II supplementar
issues.description: Third country transfer to non-adequate jurisdiction 'United States' requires Schrems II supplementary measures. Technical: NOT FOUND. Contractual: NOT FOUND. Organizational: NOT FOUND.
issues.recommended_action: Implement Schrems II supplementary measures: (1) Technical — end-to-end encryption with EU-held keys, zero-access architecture; (2) Contractual — government access notification obligation, commitment to challenge unlawful requests, transparency reporting; (3) Organizational — independent annual audit, data minimization.

issues.title: [HIGH] Annex II / TIA: Data appears to flow to US-based infrastructure (United States). US law (CLOUD Act, FISA 702) permit
issues.description: Data appears to flow to US-based infrastructure (United States). US law (CLOUD Act, FISA 702) permits government access to data held by US cloud providers. Supplementary measures addressing US-specific surveillance risks are missing or insufficient.
issues.recommended_action: For US-based transfers: (1) implement end-to-end encryption with EU-held keys; (2) ensure the data importer cannot access plaintext data; (3) add contractual commitments to challenge FISA 702 orders and notify the exporter; (4) publish a transparency report on government access requests.

issues.description: Technical: insufficient (Only basic encryption (TLS/AES) without EU-held keys or E2EE — the importer/cloud provider may still access plaintext.). Contractual: missing. Organizational: missing. Overall: insufficient.
issues.recommended_action: Technical: implement e2ee_eu_keys | Contractual: add gov_access, onward_restrictions | Organizational: establish audit, logging, key_management
